task.dimension_sampling: Independent uniform integer sides, inclusive 12..15, fold_in(seed,0x53495a45); board key=PRNGKey(seed)
task.reward: capture +/-1; nothing else from the environment
task.range_semantics: Map sides and castle counts inclusive; castle army upper bound exclusive, as in pinned upstream
task.observation_codec: 9 spatial + 5 public scalar broadcast planes, normalized; no memory
task.policy_flops_measure: counted from the jaxpr of one forward pass, batch 1, padded 16x16 board: 2 per multiply-add in convolutions and matrix products, 1 per element of other arithmetic (flops.py)

resources.practice_worker: the training shape (the submitted network runs on the GPU); charged to the research budget at its shape's price
resources.leases: 0 or 1 L40S, 1-32 CPU cores, 2-64 GiB, researcher commands, shared /scratch Volume
resources.concurrency: seconds mode (default): one active job (run, practice or lease); usd mode: 4 active jobs, at most 2 with a GPU and 64 CPU cores in total
resources.charging: seconds mode: training-worker seconds = worker seconds x cost(shape)/cost(training shape); usd mode: US dollars = worker seconds x cost(shape); cost at the frozen Modal sandbox list prices in contract.py PRICE

usd_mode.concurrency: parallel: up to 4 jobs, 2 GPUs, 64 CPU cores

commands.smoke: .venv-generals-ar/bin/python -m harness run generals network --release RELEASE --out SESSION --smoke --model MODEL --execute
